newsitem.title: USA: "Hollywood Madam" Fleiss jailed in plea-bargain.
newsitem.headline: "Hollywood Madam" Fleiss jailed in plea-bargain.

text.p: Reputed "Hollywood Madam" Heidi Fleiss pleaded guilty in a plea bargain on Monday to one count of attempted pandering and was sentenced to 18 months in prison.
In return for the guilty plea, the state dropped two other felony pandering charges and the judge ordered that her prison term run concurrently with her 37-month federal sentence for tax evasion.

Fleiss, who ran a call-girl ring catering to the rich and famous in Hollywood, was sentenced last month in federal court to 37 months for the tax evasion and money-laundering associated with the prostitution racket.
In 1995 she had been found guilty in state court of pandering -- procuring women for prostitution -- but that conviction was overturned for jury misconduct. A retrial was ordered.
Since her federal conviction, Fleiss' attorneys had been negotiating with prosecutors to drop the state retrial.
As a result of the plea-bargain, the time she serves in federal prison will count as time served in state prison.
